initiative: Reduce unplanned downtime by 30% across three sites within one year

work_packages.title: Baseline downtime measurement and root-cause analysis
work_packages.deliverable: Consolidated baseline report with root-cause taxonomy and prioritized failure modes

work_packages.title: Targeted preventive maintenance upgrades and control updates
work_packages.deliverable: Implemented upgrades and control changes with documented deliverable checklists and sign-off records

work_packages.title: Emergency response and fault detection enhancement
work_packages.deliverable: Revised response procedures, enhanced detection logic and training materials as a deliverable

work_packages.title: Non-conformance reduction and continuous monitoring
work_packages.deliverable: Non-conformance register with corrective action plans and monthly monitoring dashboard

work_packages.title: Performance validation and institutionalize controls
work_packages.deliverable: Validation report demonstrating downtime reduction, control handover and final sign-off package

approval_chain.name: Initiation gate review
approval_chain.criteria: Approve baseline report, scope and initial work package plan; confirm measurement methodology and resource commitment

approval_chain.name: Implementation gate review
approval_chain.criteria: Review completed upgrades, control changes and training; verify no outstanding deviations and permit go-live sign-off

approval_chain.name: Validation gate review
approval_chain.criteria: Accept performance validation demonstrating >=30% reduction in unplanned downtime and confirm non-conformance closure metrics

approval_chain.name: Closure and institutionalisation gate review
approval_chain.criteria: Final sign-off on deliverable package, institutional controls and operational handover with documented sign-off

compliance_notes: All activities will follow regulated change control and document retention policies; deviations must be logged and approved at gate review
Data collection and analysis will comply with internal data governance and external audit requirements
Non-conformance handling will follow established corrective action procedures with traceable evidence

risks.risk: Insufficient data quality undermines baseline and measurement of downtime reduction
risks.mitigation: Implement data validation steps, source reconciliation and independent verification prior to G1

risks.risk: Resource constraints delay implementation of preventive maintenance upgrades
risks.mitigation: Secure cross-site resource allocation in WP-01 and escalate at G1 if timelines slip

risks.risk: Operational resistance to new controls and procedures
risks.mitigation: Engage site leadership early, include training in WP-03 and require sign-off at G2
Use WP-04 to close non-conformances with corrective actions and monitor via dashboard

timeline_horizon: 12 months from initiation, aligned to quarterly gate reviews with final sign-off at end of 12 months
